visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a beige and brown patterned cardigan stands in a well-lit indoor room, speaking directly into the camera with a sincere expression. Behind him is a simple wall and a golden lamp on a wooden surface. (2) A brown chicken is shown inside a black wire cage, which sits on a cardboard base printed with text. The scene transitions to a flashback of several chickens in a dirt and grass enclosure. (3) A person wearing a dark jacket and jeans reaches down to grab a chicken from the ground. The video then cuts to a black-and-white, close-up shot of the chicken's head inside the cage, emphasizing its eyes and beak. (4) The man is shown in various indoor settings, including lying on a bed and smiling broadly at the camera while the chicken cage is visible in the background. He holds a small piece of food near the cage. (5) The setting shifts to an outdoor park with green trees and sunlight. The man stands next to the caged chicken on a wooden bench, smiling at the viewer. (6) Returning indoors, the man pours grain from a plastic bag into the chicken's bowl. A still photograph with a vintage 'Kodak Portra' border shows the man and the chicken together. (7) In the final shot, a single orange-tipped feather is held between a person's thumb and forefinger against a plain, dimly lit background with a vintage film grain effect.
